title: World2HOSI: A Multi-Expert Harness for Long-Horizon Human-Object-Scene Interaction Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27725v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon human-object-scene interaction (HOSI) is central to embodied AI, animation, and game development. Existing human-object interaction (HOI) and human-scene interaction (HSI) models excel in their respective domains, but none alone covers tasks requiring multiple interaction skills. Training unified HOSI models is hindered by scarce and costly data. We introduce World2HOSI, a multi-expert orchestration harness that generates continuous HOSI data from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and natural language instructions. Our key insight is that long-horizon HOSI hinges not on a stronger single model but on orchestration. Given a shared, structured scene state and an orchestration harness grounded in it, existing experts can jointly accomplish tasks beyond the reach of any of them alone. World2HOSI realizes this insight as a closed loop around a persistent scene state built from decoupled background and object assets. A harness

translated_title: World2HOSI：一个面向长时程人-物-场景交互生成的多专家调度框架
translated_abstract: 长时程人-物-场景交互（HOSI）是具身智能、动画和游戏开发的核心。现有的人-物交互（HOI）模型和人-场景交互（HSI）模型在各自领域表现出色，但没有单一模型能够覆盖需要多种交互技能的任务。而训练统一的HOSI模型又受到数据稀缺且获取成本高昂的阻碍。我们提出了World2HOSI，这是一个多专家调度框架，能够根据3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景和自然语言指令生成长时程连续的HOSI数据。我们的关键洞察是：长时程HOSI的关键不在于一个更强的单一模型，而在于调度编排。只要拥有一个共享的结构化场景状态，以及一个以该状态为基础的调度框架，现有的专家模型就能够联合完成任何单一模型都无法胜任的任务。World2HOSI将这一洞察实现为一个围绕持久化场景状态的闭环系统，该场景状态由解耦的背景资产和物体资产构建而成。
tldr: 该论文提出World2HOSI多专家调度框架，通过围绕共享的结构化场景状态编排现有人-物交互与人-场景交互专家模型，从3D高斯泼溅场景和自然语言指令中生成长时程连续的人-物-场景交互数据，证明了长时程HOSI的关键在于多专家协同调度而非训练更强的单一模型。
en_tdlr: World2HOSI is a multi-expert orchestration harness that generates continuous long-horizon human-object-scene interaction data from 3DGS scenes and natural language instructions, demonstrating that long-horizon HOSI hinges on orchestrating existing expert models around a shared persistent scene state rather than on a single stronger model.
